Section 1: Reading and Writing
0:00
THIS IS A TEST PREVIEW

Read the passage on the left, then answer the question on the right. Select text in the passage to highlight it (choose a color or underline). Use the ABC cross-out buttons to eliminate choices. A timer tracks how long you spend — aim for about 1 minute 11 seconds per Reading & Writing question.

If you answer incorrectly, you'll complete a mistake-log entry (minimum 2 minutes of reflection) before returning to the game.

!

Mistake Log

Slow down and work out why. Reread the passage, the correct answer, and the rationale, then fill in each section. The log unlocks after 2 minutes of reflection and 250 characters.

2:00
Minimum reflection time remaining. Use it to reread the passage and rationale.

Play style

Mistake logs

Missing a question opens a mistake log that has to be finished before you move on. Allowing skips adds a quiet "skip this log" link to it — the attempt is still recorded and the question still goes into your review queue.

Account & Sync

Cloud sync isn't configured yet. Create a free Supabase project, run the SQL in supabase-setup.sql, then paste your project URL and anon key into the CLOUD SYNC CONFIG section near the bottom of index.html (search for PASTE_YOUR). Full steps are in SUPABASE_SETUP.md.

Create a free account to keep your progress in the cloud — attempts, mistake logs, highlights, vocab, and stats sync automatically, so you can pick up on your phone exactly where you left off.

Students practice and sync progress. Only matters when creating an account — signing in always uses the type you picked originally.

Signed in as . Progress saves to your account automatically a moment after every change, and syncs down when you open the app on another device.

A linked teacher can see your attempts, mistake logs, and stats (read-only) on their dashboard, and leave comments on your questions. You can remove them any time.

2048AI — Mistake Analysis

Get a key at console.anthropic.com → API keys. Analysis runs on Claude Haiku 4.5 — a full analysis typically costs under a cent.
Attach College Board score reports or practice-test score sheets. The AI reads them alongside your mistake log to tell you what to study across both sections. PDFs are sent to the Claude API for this analysis only — nothing is stored.

Log External Mistake

Missed a question on another platform — Bluebook, Khan Academy, a prep book? Log it here so every mistake lives in one place. Paste the whole question, choices and all. It's saved to your statistics and the .xlsx export.

Question Rush

Race the clock: SAT-style questions served one at a time against a per-question countdown. One shot per question — no retries, no mistake log — and speed plus accuracy earn stars (up to ★★★ per question). The real Digital SAT gives you about 71 seconds per Reading & Writing question, so training in short timed bursts builds the pacing that keeps you from freezing on the final stretch. Misses drop straight into your review queue.
